The quotation names an "International Education Strategy" aimed at "delivering growth and opportunity, at home and abroad." The specific mechanism is a cross-border education policy designed to generate economic growth through international educational collaboration.

The primary economic content is international education policy — this sits squarely in I2 (Education and Research Institutions), as the strategy is fundamentally about education.

The international dimension ("at home and abroad," cross-border collaboration) adds a substantive F-category element — international factor movements or globalization impacts related to education exports/imports (students, institutions).

The growth framing adds an O4/O1 dimension, but it's too vague to justify a secondary code on its own.

{"primary": "I", "secondary": ["F"]}
